name: cache-meter
description: A quiet meter above the prompt: prompt cache warm or cold, time left, context size, what the next message costs warm and cold, cache hit rate and your usage limits. /cache opens the full breakdown, with an optional Keep Warm.

ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m on an API key. Set it by hand if you changed promptCacheTtl.

guard.title: Cold send guard
guard.description: confirm: hold a message sent into a cold cache once and show the price, the resend goes through. warn: only show the price. off: nothing.

keepWarm.title: Keep Warm at start
keepWarm.description: on: every new session starts with Keep Warm on. off: switch it on per session from the pane or with /cache warm.

keepWarmFor.title: Keep Warm for
keepWarmFor.description: How long after your last message Keep Warm goes on pinging. Each ping costs one cache read of the context.
